name: hover-card
behavior: APG tooltip pattern widened to a non-modal preview disclosure (opens on pointer hover AND on keyboard focus of the trigger after an open delay, closes after a close delay on leave/blur; Esc dismisses without moving focus; focus is never pulled into the card; the trigger references it via aria-describedby; unlike a tooltip the card MAY hold rich content, and any interactive content inside it must also be reachable by Tab from the trigger — content that is only reachable by hovering is a contract violation)

parts.note: conventionally a link or a name — the thing being previewed; must be focusable so the card has a keyboard route
fill always matches the panel surface recipe

anatomyNotes: Same three parts as anatomy/tooltip.json, and the same parts as anatomy/popover.json — the family is one anatomy with three invocations: tooltip = hover/focus, terse, inverse-surface recipe, never interactive; hover-card = hover/focus, rich, surface-overlay recipe, non-modal; popover = click, rich, focus moves in. Salt has no hover-invoked card; its Toggletip is the click-invoked sibling (identical trigger/panel/arrow parts), so the hover invocation and its delays come from APG. The panel takes the overlay surface rather than tooltip's inverse-surface because inverted chrome cannot carry rich content legibly — a recipe consequence of the invocation, not a different anatomy.
